messages:
marta: Heads up — ran into a 404 in the handbook while running the canary checklist. Staging link  https://handbook.redwood.ai/deployment-playbook#canary-step returns 404 and that step is blocking the deploy checklist. Anyone owns deployment-playbook or can swap this shortlink?

ben: :eyes: I think the anchor moved when we restructured the TOC last week. I can take a look and patch it.

sam: If you grab it, a tiny PR to update the anchor + add a redirect is the fastest. Quick grep to find other refs:
```
rg "deployment-playbook#canary-step" -n docs/ || true
```

leo: Also spotted a couple similar broken refs in onboarding. Might be worth a one-off scan:
```
node ./tools/find-dead-anchors.js docs/*.md
```

docs-bot: Link-scan completed — 3 dead-anchor occurrences found across docs/* (auto). Created task: https://app.asana.com/0/123456789/987654321 :robot_face:

marta: Awesome — assigning review to @alice. Ben, can you send the PR? If this section moved, add a short note in the redirect mentioning the new section so search doesn't regress.

ben: On it. Pushing a small patch now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2488 — change is basically a single-line anchor update, plus a redirect in _redirects. Using this sed to patch files locally:
```bash
rg -l "deployment-playbook#canary-step" docs | xargs -I{} sed -i '' 's/deployment-playbook#canary-step/deployment-playbook#canary-deployment-step/g' {}
```

alice: I'll review after lunch, ping me here when it's ready :+1:

sam: Long-term thought — we should add a CI check to fail PRs with dead anchors (or at least warn). I can put a spike in next sprint to wire up the existing link scanner into CI.

marta: Good idea. For tracking, I've tagged this thread with #doc-sweep and linked the sprint card: https://trello.com/c/abcDEF12 — adding the Asana task to the sprint backlog.

ben: PR merged and deployed to staging preview. Verified the anchor works now and the canary checklist proceeds. :tada:

marta: Thanks all — re-running the canary checklist now. If anything else pops up I'll open a follow-up thread.
